name: @dsh-toolset/output-compress
description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 进程内集成大输出压缩入库（确定性摘要+切片索引，经宿主共享面写入 memory-base 库）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-output-compress && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-output-compress && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-output-compress node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-output-compress tmp/cov-output-compress/report.json
